fresh_source_evidence.fact: Current INSPIRE Index Polygons release is published 5 July 2026; files remain available until the next monthly update.
INSPIRE is published monthly on the first Sunday, as local-authority GML, under the Open Government Licence; polygons are indicative rather than definitive title extents.
INSPIRE geometry is captured against British National Grid; BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection can shift some features by up to 15 metres.
LIDAR Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England and models bare-earth terrain by removing surface objects.
The persistent LIDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS supports WCS 2.0.1 and serves raw elevation coverage rather than a rendered WMS summary.
LiDAR Composite download ZIPs include a GeoPackage spatial metadata index describing spatial location and temporal extent.
Environment Agency LiDAR is supplied in OSGB36 British National Grid with elevations above Ordnance Datum Newlyn; the Composite uses OSTN15 lineage.
The current OS Terrain 50 known-data-issues page reports no live known data issues.
OS Terrain 50 per-tile metadata declares EPSG:27700 and EPSG:5701 and records earliest/latest flying dates.
The previous strict12 adapter invoked a fixed Batch116 PROJ gate whose hard-coded probe rows were 61536-61539 rather than the planned strict12 rows 61540-61551.
automation/034 now validates the actual 12-row candidate manifest through the best non-ballpark OSTN15 transformation and preserves zero measurement writes.
automation/035 and automation/036 now cross-check strict measurement, verified JSON/GeoJSON, source hashes and local acceptance before remote GitHub readback.
